<a id="glossary-dataset-organization-experiment"></a>

## Experiment

**Glossary / Dataset organization** · **Construct**

[scalar struct]

A description of the data to analyze, including its name, frames, timing, and where to load each data source.

<details>
<summary>Interpretation and scope</summary>


For example, one experiment can describe intensity images and segmentation probabilities stored in separate folders.


</details>

<details>
<summary>MATLAB lookup</summary>


```matlab
entry = farmGlossary("Experiment", "Section", "Glossary");
```


</details>

Inputs: { `DatasetID`\* = text; `Frames`\* = numeric vector; `Sources`\* = struct of named source structs; `TimeStep` = positive numeric scalar (default 1); `TimeUnit` = text (default 'frame'); }

[Source entry](../../GLOSSARY-CAPABILITIES.md?plain=1#L118)

<a id="glossary-dataset-organization-data-source"></a>

## Data source

**Glossary / Dataset organization** · **Construct**

[scalar struct]

A description of where and how to load data, including the file format, array axes, and spatial calibration.

<details>
<summary>Interpretation and scope</summary>


Create a data source with `farmMakeSource`. Look up this entry with `farmGlossary("Source")` or `farmGlossary("Data source")`; both names return the same entry. Use `help farmMakeSource` for supported options and defaults. Creating a source description does not load the data.

Required markers depend on Format; file fields are not required for a custom loader.


</details>

<details>
<summary>MATLAB lookup</summary>


```matlab
entry = farmGlossary("Data source", "Section", "Glossary");
```


</details>

Inputs: { `Format` = text; `Folder`\* = text (file source); `NamePattern`\* = text (file source); `DatasetPath`\* = text (HDF5 source); `Loader`\* = function handle (custom source); `SourceAxes` = text; `Spacing` = numeric vector; `SpacingUnit` = text; `Channels` = numeric vector; `TimeIndex` = numeric scalar; }

[Source entry](../../GLOSSARY-CAPABILITIES.md?plain=1#L125)

## Time step

**Glossary / Dataset organization**

[numeric scalar; default 1]
